brotherhood.title: A brigade founded by friends.
brotherhood.origin: VIT started on {server} as a group of friends with a shared passion for {game}. We are predominantly French-speaking, with English-speaking members as well. Some of us have been playing together for several years.
brotherhood.name: Our name, {name}, references the Vatallus from {game} lore and the Knights Templar, a nod to the brigade''s French roots.
brotherhood.ambition: We play together in PvP and wars, as well as farming and hunting bosses. Our goal is to establish VIT as a leading brigade on OSR, with a roster we can rely on.
brotherhood.wars: During Mother Ships and Outpost Wars, each of our formations includes an M-Gear, who often takes on the role of shotcaller. We use voice comms to coordinate our play and run private PvP sessions with brigade members to improve our teamwork and refine our strategies.
brotherhood.commitment: We want OSR to remain active and competitive. We currently play for {nation}, but we are willing to consider switching nations as a brigade if that is what the server needs. The future of OSR matters more to us than a short-term advantage in-game.

brotherhood.name: Brotherhood
brotherhood.text: We share our experience, advice and resources. Whether we are farming, working on a build or practising PvP, we make time to help each other.
brotherhood.principle: we help each other and share our experience.

loyalty.name: Loyalty
loyalty.text: We are looking for members who want to stay with the brigade for the long run. A better offer of gear or WP should not outweigh a commitment to the people you play with.
loyalty.principle: we value long-term commitment to the brigade over material advantages.

honour.name: Honour
honour.text: We respect opponents just as much as allies. Rivalry and light-hearted banter are part of the game, as long as they stay respectful. Cheating and personal attacks have no place in VIT.
honour.principle: we respect opponents and allies; cheating and personal attacks are not accepted.

respect.name: Respect
respect.text: we respect every player and the server rules.
respect.principle: we respect every player and the server rules.

discipline.name: Discipline
discipline.text: during wars, we follow calls and join Discord voice comms, at least to listen.
discipline.principle: during wars, we follow calls and join Discord voice comms, at least to listen.

excellence.name: Excellence
excellence.text: We work on our PvP, coordination and strategies through training and wars. When a call or a formation does not work, we take the time to understand why.
excellence.principle: we improve through training and constructive self-reflection.

support.name: Mutual support
support.text: we help our members and prioritise teamwork.
support.principle: we help our members and prioritise teamwork.

competitive.name: Competitive spirit
competitive.text: we play to win while respecting everyone''s enjoyment of the game and real-life commitments.
competitive.principle: we play to win while respecting everyone''s enjoyment of the game and real-life commitments.

cta.title: Join VIT
cta.text: We are recruiting players who know AceOnline, enjoy PvP and want to commit to a brigade for the long run. We take wars seriously while respecting everyone''s availability.
cta.criteria: We consider all Gear types. French-speaking applicants are prioritised, but international applications are welcome. There is no minimum level requirement.
cta.notice: Applications cannot be submitted at this time.

before.title: Before joining VIT
before.intro: We value AceOnline experience, the right attitude and a willingness to play as a team. Here is what you should know before applying.

profile.label: Your profile
profile.text: We are looking for experienced, respectful players who want to get involved in the brigade. There is no minimum level requirement. All Gear types are considered, with M-Gears currently prioritised. French-speaking applicants are preferred, but English-speaking players are also considered.

life.label: Life in the brigade
life.text: We play together in PvP and wars, as well as farming and hunting bosses. We also run private PvP training sessions. During wars, joining Discord voice comms is mandatory, at least to listen, so everyone can follow calls and stay coordinated. You do not have to speak if you are uncomfortable doing so.
life.more: We are competitive, but we all have lives outside the game. We respect everyone''s personal, family and work commitments.

trial.label: A one-month trial period
trial.text: New members go through a one-month trial period. This gives us time to play together, get to know each other and see whether we are a good fit. Advice and support are part of brigade life; help with gear may be considered after successfully completing the trial, depending on individual needs and available resources.

code.label: The VIT code
code.text: We expect members to respect other players, the server rules and their commitments to the brigade. PvP rivalry and light-hearted banter are welcome as long as they remain respectful. Cheating, toxicity, personal attacks and putting individual interests ahead of the team are not accepted.
